name: com.sgonzalezrozo.fast-ioc
description: Dependency injection (IoC container) for Unity with edit-time generated code: no runtime reflection, missing bindings and cycles reported before Play Mode, per-feature installers. Verified with IL2CPP on Android, iOS and WebGL.

samples.description: The README quick start: a service, an installer and an injected MonoBehaviour.
Checks injection, Lazy/Func, prefabs and initialization in a player build on any platform, with results on screen.
